description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon/rules/upwind1_D_lon_periodic driven by problems/latlon_advection_zonal_upwind.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — NLON is the open metaparameter (NLAT is edge-closed at 5; the lat axis is passive), and the problem's dlon_deg observed divides by the NLON name, so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. Exact solution sin((pi/180)(lon - omega t)) cos((pi/180) lat) (derivation in the problem file); the recorded errors at t=0.5 are dominated by first-order upwind amplitude damping (numerical diffusion), a relative L2 error ~O(dlon) — approximately 1.42e-1 / 7.41e-2 / 3.78e-2 / 1.91e-2 over the NLON ladder, an O(dlon) sequence. The resolution ladder matches the centered case (latlon_advection_zonal_periodic). expected_order is 1.0; order_tolerance is loosened modestly to 0.15 (from the centered case's 0.2 being tighter around order 2) because a first-order upwind scheme approaches its asymptotic order 1 from below in the pre-asymptotic regime — the observed per-interval orders run 0.94 -> 0.97 -> 0.99 with a median near 0.97, so 0.15 gives comfortable margin while still gating a genuine order-1 claim (this matches the sibling cartesian upwind case advection_1d_periodic, which uses the same 0.15 for the same reason).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned to match the cartesian problems' convention: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 keeps Python temporal truncation negligible against the spatial goldens (the upwind-advection system is non-stiff but weakly dissipative, where loose explicit tolerances would add spurious dissipation on top of the scheme's own).
